tables.name: notifications
tables.reason: Source ORM model defines user_id (required, users FK ON DELETE CASCADE), type String(50) required, title String(150) required, message Text required, nullable link String(255), is_read Boolean default false, and created_at. Target Notification instead requires a recipient and restricts type to a fixed lowercase enum, stores body instead of message, derives read state from readAt, adds actor/resource fields, and uses automatic timestamps. Keep mapping pending until actual source type values, source constraints, and an explicit conversion for type/message/link/read state are reviewed.

tables.name: blocks
tables.reason: Source ORM model defines id, blocker_id, blocked_id, and created_at; blocker_id and blocked_id reference users.id with ON DELETE CASCADE, both are indexed, and uq_blocker_blocked enforces pair uniqueness. Target Block model mirrors the relationship shape, but keep mapping pending until the captured PostgreSQL constraints, indexes, nullability/defaults, row counts, and any RLS policies are verified against the live source snapshot.

tables.name: reports
tables.reason: Source ORM model defines reporter_id (required, users FK ON DELETE CASCADE), reported_user_id (nullable, users FK ON DELETE CASCADE), reported_exchange_id (nullable, exchanges FK ON DELETE SET NULL), required category String(50), required details Text, status default PENDING (source comment lists PENDING/RESOLVED/DISMISSED), nullable admin_note Text, and created_at. Target Report currently uses targetType/targetId, reason, details, lowercase statuses, resolutionNote/resolvedBy, and automatic createdAt/updatedAt; this is not a field-for-field match. Keep mapping pending until source constraints and actual status values are reviewed and a deliberate transformation is specified, including user-only and exchange-only reports.

tables.name: connections
tables.reason: Source columns, foreign keys, uniqueness, indexes, and source application code support a dedicated user-to-user community Connection model, separate from exchanges. Target model is provisional only; inventory status values and source row semantics, then review the complete schema snapshot before approving field mappings or import.
